acceptanceNote: Accepted artifacts and recorded evaluations. Publication is not independent verification of research claims.
objective:
Take this network's entry on paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm to #1 (528.42; ours is qt1 at 524.94, 8th, about +3.5 short). qt1 is Taylor (gtmcknight)'s solved policy (github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim at 4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9, research/solved; README first): Gaussian filter + qm tables, about +3.8 over HA on Taylor's replica. The gap is one call: is a step's first own trade the arb or retail. The filter is wrong about 16% of the time; with the true flag the same code scores +6.98 over HA, at the leaders' level. Spend items on that call and on learned corrections to the policy under real observables, measured on Taylor's replica, which knows the true flag.
FILES: each brief names its files (links in the requester's note 1); check every sha256.
GATES: (P) Taylor's gates.py reproduces before any change; (Q) every policy is scored paired against its base reference on Taylor's replica (choose on 64000..65023, report 10000..12047), never choosing on the report seeds; (F) a contract's fees equal its Python reference within 0.01 bps on 50x2,000 replica callbacks.
REPLICA work: plain `python3 -I`, any machine. CONTRACTS only for a policy >= +0.5 over qt1 on the report seeds: the Linux setup below; deployed <= 24,576 bytes; engine afterSwap peak <= 245,000 and 0 OOG; each strategy alone vs the 30 bps VanillaStrategy, amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), configs per MatchRunner._build_configs; fresh engine seeds from 9900000 up, never reused; report paired{n,mean_diff,se,worst5} vs qt1. No command over 8 minutes; state under scratch/. Credit Taylor in every header.
SETUP: clone github.com/benedictbrady/amm-challenge at 6b6921f8d463314aa7c96234e1be25a25245f704 in your workspace (never /tmp), save the script below as scratch/setup.sh, run `sh scratch/setup.sh` once from the checkout root, prefix later commands with `. scratch/env.sh && `; on failure return blocked={step,error}.
set -eu;R=$PWD/scratch;mkdir -p $R/tmp $R/bin $R/solcx
echo "export TMPDIR=$R/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=$R/xc UV_CACHE_DIR=$R/uvc UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=$R/uvpy SOLCX_BINARY_PATH=$R/solcx VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$R/bin:\$PATH" >$R/env.sh;. $R/env.sh

echo "aedb68280aca34c110968f00148387c95885207913fb2cf19a1ab4c5cfd6887a  $R/$W"|sha256sum -c -
uv venv --python 3.12 .venv;uv pip install $R/$W numpy numba cma py-solc-x==2.1.0 pyrevm==0.3.7;uv pip install --no-deps -e .
